useless_stretcher.configuration.title: Useless Stretcher Configuration
useless_stretcher.configuration.accelera: Automatically throttle idle machines in permanent mode to save performance. Normal mode always runs at full speed.
Disable the target mob's AI while it is accelerated, then restore its previous state.
useless_stretcher.configuration.recipe_c: Hide grinding-ball recipe variants for the Ender IO SAG Mill.
useless_stretcher.configuration.dimensio: Block IDs that cannot be used for quad/nine-chunk dimension floors and borders.
When non-empty, only listed blocks may be used for quad/nine-chunk dimension floors and borders.
useless_stretcher.configuration.staff_le: Enable leaf staff drop easter egg
Allow a very rare Chronoshift Staff drop when breaking leaves.
Value from 0 to 1; 0.00001 is one in one hundred thousand.
useless_stretcher.configuration.summonin: Disabled by default. When disabled, the summon controls remain visible but do not spawn mobs.
useless_stretcher.configuration.loot_ref: Disabled by default. Enable this before players can turn on vanilla and Lootr loot chest refresh in the X screen.
